svg.aria-label: Eight errors made during the fleet promotion, each with what it cost and the gate that catches it next time
svg.text: each mistake of the pass, what it cost, and the check that now catches it before a merge

g.text: 1 a pipeline that could not stop
pytest | tail -1 returns tail's status
a failing test shipped; a tag whose
VERSION had not moved; a failing guard merged
every step gated on its own exit code;
set -o pipefail in every chain
2 a version bump by substitution
sed over the whole tree
app_version rewritten inside 34 committed
artifacts; a historical sentence in a guide
the bump tool moves version sources only;
artifacts regenerated under the pin
3 a colon in a YAML step name
"Guards: content and budget"
the workflow did not parse: shown under
its file path with zero jobs, silently
yaml.safe_load on every workflow before
commit; the comma form only in YAML
4 footer constants the bump missed
a version typed into a component
a site stuck at 0.08.000 in its footer
for fourteen releases
the bump sets the constant to the target
whatever it read; the bundle checked
5 an emoji tidy regex
strip and collapse in one pass
the newline after 17 docstrings collapsed
into the next statement
from HEAD; same-line edits only,
and the diff read before the commit
6 a PR head deleted before the merge
the branch went first
a stranded pull request, its commits
only in the reflog
merge first; delete the head after
the API reports merged: true
7 a tag without a release, 8 rows written from intent
created and deleted the same minute; a ledger row for a tag that did not exist
tag on the release merge only; every row
re-read from the repo before writing

svg.text: A poll that treated "pending" as terminal is the ninth, from the engine extraction the same week: CI must reach "completed" and read its conclusion.
